title: Music Row Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
*Discover the heart and soul of Nashville’s music industry.**
>
> Skip the tourist-heavy crowds of Lower Broadway and step onto the legendary pavement of Music Row. Led by Joe Nashville—a 31-year Tennessee local—this intimate 1.5-hour walking tour pulls back the curtain on the studios, labels, and hidden corners where chart-topping hits were born.
>
> We don't just point at buildings; we tell the stories behind the songs. From the legendary RCA Studio B to the writers' stomping grounds, you'll gain an insider's perspective on how this specific neighborhood shaped the sound of American music. Whether you're a country music history buff or just curious about the "Music City" mystique, you’ll leave with the local knowledge and legendary tales that standard guidebooks miss.
>
> * **Experience:** An easy, immersive stroll through Nashville’s true music hub.
> * **Local Expertise:** Led by a lifelong resident who knows the stories behind the studios.
> 
>
